assign.outcome: **Audited all 741 real pages under / + /framework/ + /notes/ (live tree walk) at 400/1920/3440 for above-the-fold experience.** 741 urls crawled = 741 rows in audit.json (both numbers agree). Every 0-grade reading was individually re-verified with a longer settle wait and a direct screenshot before being trusted - most were render-timing artifacts on heavy catalog/columns pages, not real defects; exactly one page is a genuine bug. Biggest single finding: the homepage and ~10 topic/module roots (framework, core, ext, ui, ux, util, dev, audit, faq, research, versus) all push their one live demo below the first 1000px - above the fold is title+nav+text only, no picture or live thing, on the highest-traffic pages on the site. Best models: framework/styles/, ext/tabs/, ext/JSONL/, ui/card/, ext/catalog/ - one compact live demo, real nav, real orienting line, all above the fold. Left for the owner: which shared root-page template to fix first (one change reaches ~10 pages); whether the 23 Files-tab 404s share one missing-asset cause; the /imagine/ audited-separately assumption held (0 hits from these three roots).
